The following charts compare the percentage breakdown of target total direct compensation for Fiscal Year 2018 for our Chief Executive Officer

We design our corporate governance framework to support the long-term interests of our stockholders and compliance with regulatory
requirements related to corporate governance. We also closely monitor governance trends and best practices. Some of our governance practices include the following:

✓
Annual election of directors

Annual say-on-pay vote

✓
